info.name: Sinay Maritime APIs CO2 Emission API
Retrieve CO2 consumption for a trip from one port to another.

items.docs: Computes the CO2 emissions of a TEU for a voyage between two ports. Identify the vessel by IMO or MMSI (not both). Departure and arrival are ports identified by 5-character UN/LOCODE. Returns voyage length in nautical miles and tons of CO2 per TEU for a vessel-model method (Tank-to-Wheel) and a GLEC Framework tradelane method (Well-to-Tank, Tank-to-Wheel, Well-to-Wheel).
